pieces.name: Blind MP7 re-comparison (round 2)
pieces.detail: DONE (2 of 3 attempts died on HTTP 429 fair-share; the third completed after 3h03m). Blind verdict: die = FAIL (the single biggest gap: visible in only 2 of 7 frames incl. a mid-roll burst, players confirming rolls from the text banner alone), star buy = PASS with reservations, happening = PASS, finale = PASS (6 separated beats verified). Three things MP7 does that we do not: no drumroll visual on the bonus reveals, the star reads as an overlay rather than a traveling icon, and (claimed) no gold edge vignette. I falsified the vignette claim by measurement - forcing .ssp-vignette solid red moved the frame average red 132.6 -> 159.0 and hiding it returned exactly 132.6 (it paints above the canvas; canvas is position:static/z-index:auto vs overlay z-80), and a real pulse contributes a 35-37 rgb edge shift with the vignette visible vs hidden. The die gap was REAL and is FIXED: punchCamera aimed only 35% of the way toward its target and pulled in 14%, leaving the die at the left edge (x 35-84px) or outside the portrait frustum (+/-9 world units at board depth) on left-side spaces; the punch also held full strength only 0.45-1.15s while the die landed late and hid 0.5s after. Now it aims AT the target, pulls 30% in, holds to 1.55s and the landed die is held 1.0s. Verified: 12/12 captures show the die with readable pips (was 2/7), settled 62-74px (16-19% of viewport width) at x 79-306, and vision reads the pips and matches the roll banner ('a red 3-D die with white pips has just landed ... the upward-facing face shows 5 pips ... easy to count ... matching Pip rolled 5!').

pieces.name: Whole-game coherence + feel pass

Its verdict CORRECTED my earlier call: 2 simultaneously visible banners in 220 samples (16.5%), 200-1800ms each, incl. 'TIME'S UP!' + 'TURN 5' and 'Funhouse Cut!' + 'Pip'S TURN!'. Root cause found by me: hud.showBanner() (src/ui/hud.ts) appended .ssp-hud-banner elements with NO queueing, in parallel with the kit's serialized queue - two banner channels on one screen. Fixed: hud banners now route through the shared queue via setHudBannerSink(), plus priority preemption (a higher-priority banner cuts off the one on screen rather than stacking). Its other finding - 18 dead-tap elements across 5 screens - is fixed for the worst case: the shop is now a real modal (.ssp-roll-wrap/.ssp-pause-fab/.ssp-hud/.ssp-item-bar -> opacity 0, visibility hidden, pointer-events none while .ssp-shop exists, via a :has() rule so no state can leak), and Escape with a modal up no longer also opens the pause menu. Verified: max simultaneous banners 1 (was 2), 0 HUD-channel banners, no dual-banner windows in 475 samples; tap where ROLL! sits leaves phase dice->dice and die=hidden; chrome returns on close; tsc 0; twin MATCH true; build ok; zero console errors.
